title: Eternal Tales
description: Eternal Tales is huge RPG mod that adds more new dimensions, bosses, skills and quests with unique lore
body:
Eternal Tales is a huge RPG storyline mod that adds more of new content: worlds, skills, quests and bosses!

Now the mod have over: 2000+ blocks, 1000+ items, 80+ sets of armor, 230+ weapons, 20+ sets of tools and 2 tools with unical usage, 80+ magic artefacts, 60+ potion effects, 130+ food and drinks, 150+ achievements, 200+ mobs, 20+ bosses and 6 minibosses, 9 new dimensions, 31 music discs, 9 skills, 10 quests.

Lore. Dimensions. Bosses. Kings and Gods. Skills System. Magic. And more!

 

 

Mod version 1.6.23 and higher (for Minecraft 1.20.1) requires Curios mod to be installed

Recommended info and QoL mods to play with this mod: Just Enough Items (shows items crafts), Just Enough Resources (shows mobs drops), Enchantment Descriptions (show enchantments descriptions)

Short Showcase of the main features 

Full guide to dimensions and some features can be found below

Dimensions of the mod

All the dimensions requires to build a portal made of bricks of this dimension and activate by crystal of this dimension (For example Comets require Comets Bricks and Comets Crystal)
All the dimensions list:
- Comets
- Purgatorium
- Gardens of Eden
- Rayana
- Lands of Karvat
- Volcanech
- Kingdom of Amber
- Unahzaal
- Ultimate World

Also you can use Fourteenth Flame for the fast travelling into any world

Journal with skills and quests

Most of progression features could be found in Journal or on the Notice Board. There's 10 skills in mod now, they and the other things could be found in Journal

 

Version 8.0 Aftermath trailers

Version 1.2: Deep into the Nether - trailer:

 

Version 1.4: Final - Trailers!

 

Version 1.6: Let us tell you a Story - Trailers!

 

 

 

Brief description of the passing mod:

Vivid boss stage:

First, you need to mine Ruby that spawns in geodes like Amethysts — use a Diamond Pickaxe for this, then craft a Ruby Pickaxe. With this Pickaxe, you can mine Cobalt and craft a Cobalt Pickaxe.
After that, look on the plains or in the forest for a special dungeon that looks like a huge fortress. This is the Vivid Maze.
You must pass through it, and on the top floor you will find the Vivid Statue. It can only be destroyed by a Cobalt Pickaxe, and breaking it summons the boss — Vivid.
After defeating Vivid, go to the Nether — but first upgrade your Cobalt Pickaxe using Livetree Sawdust.

 

Dead Egyptian Martyr boss:

In the Nether, you need to gather materials from new mobs:

  • Profaned Crystal (Damaged Infected Crystal in older versions) — Drops from Melters that spawn in Nether Wastes, Basalt Deltas, and the new Profaned Forest biome.
  • Destroyer's Eye — Drops from Inferns that spawn in Nether Wastes, Basalt Deltas, and Crimson Forest.
  • Bone Shard — Drops from Butchers that spawn in Nether Wastes, Crimson Forest, and Bleeding Caverns.
  • Basalt Ore — Spawns anywhere in the Nether.

 

Craft two Ashy Scarabs from these materials.
Find a pyramid in the desert — at its entrance you will see a scarab mural, which opens the door. Inside, proceed to the main hall, opening doors with Nether materials.
You will find an altar with 8 pillars around it. Activate it with a Scarab — mobs will begin spawning and attacking you. These mobs drop special materials. After you defeat 9 of them, you receive an activated drop. Use it on the altar when the pillars extinguish to advance to the next level. After passing enough levels, the boss — Dead Egyptian Martyr — will appear.

 

Infected Kraken boss:

Next, head to the Mucunfectio Biomes (Mucunfectio Beach, Mucunfectio Cliffs, Mucunfectio Abyss, and Mucunfectio Caves) — distinctive blue biomes. There you need to find these materials:

  • Sea Prism — Drops from Prismatic Ore and Infected Ceratioidei mobs that spawn in Infected Dungeons. Also found in Infected Dungeon chests.
  • Infected Shrimp — Drops from Infected Shrimp.
  • Infected Meat — Drops from Infected Zombies.
    Craft the Kraken Bait and summon the Infected Kraken in any Mucunfectio Biome during rain (rain can be started with the Storm Emblem dropped by Vivid — or by command if you're a cheater).

 

Comets dimension and Terrible Tree boss:

After that, you can head to the flying islands you may have noticed in the sky. There, find a ruined portal, complete it, and activate it with a Comets Crystal. Portal blocks can also be crafted from Comet Brick and Cloud Concrete, which drop from Vivid and Dead Egyptian Martyr.

 

Comets Crystal Craft (in Interdimensional Creator)

Requires 2 Sorcery Skill Level (only on 1.19.2+ versions)

 

Ingredients:

1. Ancienzyte-Framed Bleedwood (crafted from Bleedwood and Ancienzyte, both found in the Nether)

2. Inverted Mud (crafted from Mud — before 1.19.2 versions, Mud spawns as ore in Jungles — and Cleaning Powder)

3. Terra Crystal (drops from mod Overworld mobs)

4. Grave Dirt (craft a Grave and place it in a dark place; it will summon Grave Zombies, which drop Grave Dust, from which Grave Dirt can be crafted)

5. Hyacinthum Gold Block (craft Hyacinthum Grass Block and place a Gold Block nearby. WARNING: Infection spreads, so place it on non-infectable blocks, e.g. Glass)

 


You will enter a new world — Comets. There, find or mine Aerolite Nuggets and craft an Aerolite Axe.
After that, make a Grave. When placed in a dark place, Cemetery Zombies spawn on it. Kill them and craft Cemetery Dirt from their drops. Combine that Dirt with the Axe to get a Tragedy Axe (Axe of Evil in older versions).
When you break a Comets tree log with this axe, you summon the boss — Terrible Tree.

 

Rock-Blaze boss:

After defeating Terrible Tree, go to the Nether and find a fortress made of indestructible bricks. On the top floor, there will be an altar. Click on it with Hellfire to summon the boss — Rock-Blaze.

Hellfire can be crafted from: 

  • Fire Oil — Drops from Livetree Fire Traps in the Vivid Maze. The fastest tool to break them is an Axe.
  • Fire Charge.
  • Glowlichen — Can be grown on a Gardener's Pot. See the Growing Skill section below for details.
  • Skylite Ingot — Smelted from Skylite Ore in Comets, or dropped by Terrible Tree.
  • Aerolite Alloy Ingot — Nuggets can be found in Comets chests or dropped by Terrible Tree.
  • Ashy Scarab.

Right-click Rock-Blaze with an Asteroid Stone to obtain Hellrock, which is needed to enter Purgatorium.

 

 

Purgatorium dimension and Nyetet, the Fallen Titan boss:

The Purgatorium portal can be found in the Nether.

 

Purgatorium Crystal.

Requires 4 Sorcery Skill Level (only on 1.19.2+ versions)

 

Ingredients:

1. Nether Fire Moss Block (can be found in the Nether as ore or plant)

2. Skylite Ingot.

3. Lapsidian Ingot (smelted from Lapsidian Dust, which is crafted from Lapis Lazuli Blocks and Obsidian)

4. Aerolite Ingot.

5. Hellrock.

 



Then you need to collect the three Parts of the Fallen Rune in Purgatorium.
The first part drops from Rock-Blaze; the second part is crafted from materials dropped by Purgatorium mobs; the third part is bought from the Purgatorium Wanderer.

Second part materials: 

  • Phantom Fire — Drops from Purgatorium Phantom.
  • Agate — Drops from Thin.
  • Blood Stone — Drops from Purgatory Watcher.


Find the Fallen Tower and go inside. Activate the special altar with the Fallen Rune.
The boss — Nyetet, The Fallen Titan — will be spawned.

 

Gardens of Eden dimension and Jaghax boss:

The portal to Eden can be found in the End.

 

Gardens of Eden Crystal.

Requires 6 Sorcery Skill Level (only on 1.19.2+ versions)

 

Ingredients:

1. Silver Block — Silver spawns as ore in the End.

2. Sunstone (Sunstone Nugget on 1.18.2) — Sunstone Shards drop from Nyetet.

3. Dragon Breath.

4. Sunstone (Sunstone Nugget on 1.18.2).

5. Monster Blindness — Grows on a Gardener's Pot. See the Growing Skill section below. Monster Blindness can be found in the following Purgatorium biomes: Purgatorium Wasteland, Purgatorium Bone Wasteland, and Purgatorium Taiga.

 

 


Craft the Jaghax Lamp from:

  • Fire Oil. 
  • Soulbone — can be bought from the Sunfurry Messiah in the Church structure.
  • Djinn's Lamp — Drops from Sjinns in the Prison structure.

 


Activate the Lamp in Eden to spawn Jaghax.

 

Next, you can go to either of two dimensions — Rayana or Lands of Karvat. 

 

Rayana dimension and Pterion boss:

The Rayana portal can be found in Jungles or in the Big Wolf Skeleton structure in Purgatorium.

 

Rayana Crystal Craft.

Requires 9 Sorcery Skill Level (only on 1.19.2+ versions)

 

Ingredients:

1. Darkplasm.

2. Soulbone.

3. Destroyer's Eye.

4. Sunhog Leather.

5. Nether Fish (see the Fishing Skill section below for how to catch it).

 

In Rayana, you need to craft a Bloody Eye and summon the boss Pterion by clicking on the Bloody Altar. The Altar can be found in the Pterion Cave — look for pillars of cobblestone-like blocks and dig down.

 

Bloody Eye is crafted from: 

  • Topaz — spawns as ore in Rayana at Y = 50–319.
  • Turquoise — spawns as ore in Rayana at Y = 0–200.
  • Vampyre Jewel — drops from Vampyres and Falpyres in Rayana.
  • Fermented Tarantula Eye — crafted from Tarantula Eye (Tarantulas spawn in Rayana or in vanilla spawner dungeons), Tropical Sugar (crafted from Tropical Reeds that grow in the Rayana Reed Grove biome, or found in Rayana Interdimensional Structure chests), and Profaned Mushrooms (grow in the Nether Profaned Forest biome).

 

 

Lands of Karvat dimension, Arla, Haciru, Ikkorh and Hirots mini bosses, and Enicrih boss:

The Lands of Karvat portal spawns in the Comets.

 

Lands of Karvat Crystal.

Requires 9 Sorcery Skill Level (only on 1.19.2+ versions)

 

Ingredients:

1. Darkplasm — Drops from Jaghax.

2. Soulbone.

3. Comet Crystal — Crafted from Comets Shards that drop from Banshees and Cometheads in the Phantom Tower structure in Comets.

4. Spore Edennus — Grows in Eden.

5. Nether Eel (see the Fishing Skill section below).

 

In the Lands of Karvat, find the god Gulibeg in the orange temple. He gives you a quest to kill 4 minibosses and the boss Enicrih, along with the items needed to summon them. Go to 4 pyramid-like temples and defeat the 4 minibosses: Arla, Haciru, Hirots, and Ikkorh. Then enter the black cube dungeon, clear it, and defeat the boss Enicrih. After that, speak with Gulibeg again. 

 

Arahulum boss:

Then craft the Ender Artefact and summon Arahulum in a special structure in the End.

Crafting materials: 

- Ichor — Drops from Gulibeg's Reward (given after killing Enicrih) and also from Enicrih itself after receiving the reward.

- Dark Ichor — Drops from Enicrih.

- End Crystal — Crafted from End Shards that drop from End mobs. 

- Eye of Ender.

 

After Arahulum's death, a new ore — Aragotium — begins to spawn in the End. Its spawn method varies by mod version, but always appears in newly generated chunks: 

In 1.16.5 — spawns as normal ore.

In 1.18.2 — spawns on Enchanted Asteroids.

In 1.19.2 — spawns on Enchanted Islands.

 

Enchanted Islands.

Spawns only in 1.19.2. This is a structure where Aragotium Ore generates. Enchanted Totems spawn here, and Eye of Arahulum spawners also generate. Note: Eye of Arahulum gains resistance to any damage when an Enchanted Totem is within a 30‑block radius. 

 

Volcanech dimension and Volcanic Golem boss:

The Volcanech portal spawns in the Eden Volcano structure (or just in Gardens of Eden in 1.18.2 and earlier).

 

Volcanech Crystal.

Requires 13 Sorcery Skill Level (only on 1.19.2+ versions)

 

Ingredients:

1. Ichor.

2. Tayemiyadoht Tapinella (Grows on a Gardener's Pot; see the Growing Skill section below).

3. Aragotium Ingot.

4. Armored Chitin — Drops from Armored Beetles in the Lands of Karvat.

5. Dark Ichor.

Collect materials from this dimension:

  • Uranium — ore from Volcanech. 
  • Melting Volcanite — drops from Vulcs. 
  • Melting Sulfur — drops from Sulfeers.
  • Pyronzyte Ingot — drops from Executioners.
  • Chiseled Ashstone — crafted from Ashstone at a Stonecutter. Ashstone is crafted from Ash, which can be found in the Ash Dunes biome in Volcanech.

 

Craft a Flame Sphere from these materials. Right-click any spawner in Volcanech with the Flame Sphere to spawn Flame Spheres mobs. Kill them to obtain Pyro Volcanite. Then right-click the Volcanech Golem Statue with Pyro Volcanite to summon the boss — Volcanic Golem.

 

Kingdom of Amber dimension and Xaxxas XIX boss:

The Kingdom of Amber portal spawns in Volcanech.

 

Kingdom of Amber Crystal

Requires 16 Sorcery Skill Level (only on 1.19.2+ versions)

 

Ingredients:

1. Pharos (crafted from Blaze Powder, Glowstone Dust, Geobstractsite Dust — crafted from any blocks from the Geobstractsite biome that generates near the bedrock layer in the Overworld — and an Ayeris Bottle; see Sorcery Skill).

2. Illuminati Fish (see the Fishing Skill section below).

3. Flame Sphere.

4. Truadamantite Ingot — Crafted from Adamantite Ingot, Venetium Ingot, Tungsten Ingot, Netherite Ingot, Phantom Membrane, and Brimstone Fungi (found in the Brimstone Cave biome that spawns under vanilla Mushroom biomes).

5. Crystal of the Greatness (or Fragment of the Greatness in 1.18.2 versions) — Drops from Flame Spheres.

 

 

Progression through this dimension differs by version:

1.18.2 and before:
When you enter the portal, a chest appears near you. Inside is a note that tells a short history of Amber and provides the key to the maze.

 

1.19.2+:

After some time in the Kingdom of Amber, if you have no active quests, an Amber Robber NPC will spawn. He gives you a quest to find the Amber Maze.

 

From this point, progression is the same for all versions.

Next, find the Amber Maze, which appears 2000 blocks west of the first portal to Amber. 
You need to navigate the labyrinth and find the central room — the Planetarium. There is a wall with the history of Amber. After reading it, you can summon the boss of Amber — but where is he?

Amber Castle is located 2000 blocks east of the first portal in Amber. Inside is the Royal Altar. If you have read the history of Amber, you can summon the king of Amber — Xaxxas XIX. 
This boss can summon his warriors; when they are near him, Xaxxas is invincible. However, when a warrior takes damage, Xaxxas also takes damage. 

 
Unahzaal

Next, speak with Miguel. He will disappear and drop the Black Book. Place it somewhere to obtain the materials for building the Unahzaal Portal and the Cursed Page. Craft a Damaged Astral from the Cursed Page and mod swords, then craft the Unahzaal Crystal.

 

Unahzaal Crystal

Requires 20 Sorcery Skill Level (only on 1.19.2+ versions)

None of the ingredients are consumed in this craft.

 

Ingredients:

1. Kingdom of Amber Crystal.

2. Comets Crystal.

3. Damaged Astral.

4. Gardens of Eden Crystal.

5. Volcanech Crystal.

 

After that, you can enter the Unahzaal dimension and pass the labyrith to fight the boss. 

Arkemer Quest

This is the final mod's quest. After defeating Unahzaal in the overworld, you’ll see small structures in the sky. You need to reach them and activate them using Ageagoria — an item that drops from Unahzaal.

When you activate a structure with Ageagoria, a dungeon will appear that you’ll need to complete. You’ll figure everything out as you go, and the quest NPCs will guide you. There will be a total of 6 dungeons with different challenges. Again, the NPCs will tell you where to find them. The only thing I really want to prepare you for is the battle against the final boss, Tetragrammaton. Tetragrammaton Battle Let’s start with the recommended gear. Great Emblem is MANDATORY. Without it, there’s a high chance you’ll be one shoted Great Unahzaal Armor and the final weapon corresponding to your class (Restored Astral for the Warrior, Rocket's Gun for the Ranged, Bloody Anchor for the Mage, Curious Eye for the Summoner) The Ultimate Two would also be a good addition, as it has immunity to many types of damage and can stun bosses when they attack you Upon entering the final arena, the Tetragrammaton will begin summoning bosses. First, he will summon the boss Quetzalcoatl. Its mechanics are as follows: it is a segmented boss. Only its head can take damage. The segments can shoot and summon mobs. If you damage the segments enough, they will stop functioning and lose their abilities. Quetzalcoatl’s head has a rapid-fire attack where it fires very quickly for a short period of time. It also has a pull attack. Be prepared to be pulled in for damage. You can avoid this by keeping a safe distance during the fight or by getting stuck in blocks. Let’s also talk abour boss’s minions:

  • Arkemer Warbot - a mob that simply attacks at close range,
  • Arkemer Wargun - a ranged mob,
  • Arkemer Band - a mob that splits into 3 more mobs upon death,
  • Arkemer Healing Tank - the most important of the minions; it can very quickly heal all Arkemer bosses within a large radius and attack you. These should be destroyed first,

 

Also, when any of the minions are near the bosses, they grant a small regeneration effect to the bosses

When Quetzalcoatl is at 50% health or lower, a second boss Chac-Mool will be summoned. Chac-Mool will also summon bosses when he reaches 50% HP, so the number of bosses in the arena by the end of the fight depends entirely on you, but it is recommended to defeat Quetzalcoatl before moving on to Chac-Mool so you can focus on the other bosses
Chak-Mool primarily attacks at close range but also has a hammer attack. When he strikes the ground, he attacks everyone within a certain radius, knocks them into the air, and stuns them. Chak-Mool can also grant himself a speed boost for a short time. Chak-Mool can also begin summoning projectiles in the form of black holes falling from the sky, which explode and inflict Sun Flames and Aetherium Poison effects.

 

When Chak-Mool has 50% or less HP, he summons two bosses at once Adam and Eve. It is recommended to finish off Chak-Mool first or start with Eve, as she is the most dangerous boss at this point. Eve fires slow-moving projectiles, but they still deal a lot of damage and also heal Eve very effectively. Be even more wary of Eve’s melee attacks—they deal even more damage; a few seconds is enough to die from them. Eve can also teleport to the player. It’s best to dodge the teleport to avoid a melee attack. Eve doesn’t teleport instantly and has an animation before teleporting; she becomes two-dimensional and then disappears. If you move during this, she will most likely not have time to attack you.

 

Adam has only ranged attacks. When his arrows hit a mob or a block, they create Radioactive Clouds, and the rain from these clouds attacks everyone beneath them.

 

When Adam and Eve have less than 50% HP, the final boss Tetragrammaton himself is summoned. He has both melee and ranged attacks, which also summon Radioactive Clouds and heal Tetragrammaton. He can also summon Black Holes. When the Tetragrammaton has 50% or less HP, he will drop to one knee. During this time, he cannot be attacked and will regenerate. A passage will open behind his throne, which you must rush through. There you will find the Arkemer Servers. You must destroy them. As soon as the Tetragrammaton finishes regenerating to full health, it will teleport you to its location and close the passage. If you haven’t managed to destroy all the Servers, it will kneel again and open the passage. You need to repeat this until you destroy all the Servers. After that, the Tetragrammaton will no longer kneel, and you will be able to kill him

 

Additional Guides:

 

Ultimate World

 

There is also one more world — a joke world. 
The Ultimate World

The first time you can reach it in only one way: obtain the Fourteenth Flame book from the Unahzaal boss. This book can teleport you to any dimension, including the Ultimate World. After that, you can find Ultimate Bricks in small structures in this world and build the portal. 
The Ultimate Crystal craft:
1. Unahzaal Crystal

2. Rayana Crystal

3. Ultimate Bricks

4. Lands of Karvat Crystal

5. Purgatorium Crystal

 

All Damaged Astral Swords crafts:

Divine Edge — Crafted from Soul Edge and Amber Star (can be bought from Amber Trader).
Royal Greatsword — Drops from Xaxxas XIX.
Toxic Sword — Crafted from Uranium Sword and Melting Sulfur.
Royal Slayer — Crafted from Cephalopods Slayer, Warzzinoth, Bloody Rapier, Grand Minecraft Sword, Ravrite Honeycomb (see the Ravrite Nest section below), and Amber Star.
Bloody Talwar — Crafted from Greatest Sword and Vampyre Blood (drops from Pterion).
Blue Cutlass — Can be found in the Amber Maze or drops from Xaxxas XIX.
Raitoningu — Nightingale's Sword (Ryusuke Sword in older versions), Amber Cudgel, Beta Ray Bill Stormbreaker, Hellrock (right-click Rock-Blaze with Asteroid Stone), and Hellrock (block).
Truadamantite Sword — Truadamantite Ingot, Adamantite Sword, Stick. See Sorcery Skill below for crafting materials.
Cursed Page — Drops from Miguel after killing Xaxxas XIX. 

Soul Edge — Crafted from Ghost Edge and Soul Fragment (crafted from Soul Spark, which drops from Broken Soul and Mists in Soul Sand Valley).
Ghost Edge — Crafted from Comets Sword, Ender Sword, Ender Crystal (crafted from Ender Shards that drop from End mobs), Golden Dust (drops from Golden Golems that spawn in a structure in Comets), and Comets Crystals Block (Comets Crystal Shards drop from Banshees and Cometheads in the Ghost Tower structure in Comets).
Comets Sword — Crafted from Comets Crystal and Obsidian Sticks (crafted from Obsidian).
Ender Sword — Ender Crystal, Profaned Crystal (Damaged Infected Crystal in older versions; drops from Melters in Nether Wastes, Basalt Deltas, and Profaned Forests), Obsidian Stick, Stone Stick, and End Rod.
Uranium Sword — Crafted from Uranium (Volcanech ore) and Obsidian Stick.
Cephalopods Slayer — Crafted from Prismatic Sword, Lapsidian Ingot, Netherite Plate, Plague Oil (drops from Livetree Plague Traps in the Vivid Maze), Geobstractsite Dust, and Hyacinthum Gold Block.
Prismatic Sword — Drops from Infected Kraken.
Warzzinoth — Ritual Knife, Guardian's Sword, Mechasword, Reinforced Sword, Sword of Divine Flames, Tim Sword, Pyronzyte Ingot (drops from Executioners in Volcanech), and Flame Sphere.
Ritual Knife — Crafted from Egyptian Ritual Sword, The Divider of the Heaven, Vivid's Oathsword, and any Lands of Karvat mini boss power (Arla's Power, Haciru's Power, Ikkorh's Power, or Hirots' Power).
Egyptian Ritual Sword — Drops from Dead Egyptian Martyr. 
The Divider of the Heaven — Drops from Dead Egyptian Martyr. 
Vivid's Oathsword — Crafted from Netherite Sword, Livetree Sword, Reinforced Cobalt Sword, and Livetree Sawdust (drops from Vivid).
Livetree Sword — Drops from Vivid.
Reinforced Cobalt Sword — Crafted from Cobalt Sword and Livetree Sawdust. 
Guardian's Sword — Drops from Terrible Tree. 
Mechasword — Drops from Chaotic Creature in Gardens of Eden.
Reinforced Sword — Crafted from The Empty Sky Sword, Garnet Katana, Bleedwood Sword, Lapsidian Sword, Reinforced Cobalt Sword, Corundum Katana, Finsword, Ichor, and Dark Ichor.
The Empty Sky Sword — Crafted from Silver Ingot (Silver ore found in the End), Darkplasm (drops from Jaghax), Crystalized Glowstone Shard (found in the Blazing Wastes biome in the Nether), and Stone Stick. 
Bleedwood Sword — Crafted from Bleedwood Planks (Bleedwood found in Nether structures or the Bleeding Forest biome) and Stick. 
Finsword — Crafted from Hyacinthum Gold Ingots and Stick. 
Sword of Divine Flames — Crafted from Turquoise Katana, Topaz Katana, Ancienzyte Sword (Ancienzyte is a Nether ore), Daredian Sword, Halloween Dagger, Infernality, and Sky Finger. 
Daredian Sword — Crafted from Daredian Metal Ingots (Daredian ore spawns in Rayana, Gardens of Eden, or Volcanech) and Stick.
Halloween Dagger — Drops from Halloween Spirit. 
Infernality — Crafted from Netherskull Sword, Phantom Fire, Agate, and Bloodstone.
Netherskull Sword — Crafted from Bonespur and Nether Cog (drops from Melter).
Bonespur — Crafted from Bone and Bone Shard (drops from Butcher).
Sky Finger — Drops from Allays.
Tim Sword — Crafted from Tin (Lands of Karvat ore) and Stick.
Bloody Rapier — Crafted from Cave Greatblade, Aerolite Sword, Skylite Sword, Floweria, Vampyre Blood, and Volcanech Gravitator (drops from Volcanic Golem).
Cave Greatblade — Drops from Nyetet.
Floweria — Crafted from Spore Edennus (grows in Gardens of Eden), Black Tulip (grows in Overworld), Jannatus Flower (grows in Comets), Spore Blossom, and Biome Sword.
Biome Sword — Crafted from Grass Block, Red Sand, any Log, Bamboo, Podzol, Muddy Mangrove Roots, Gravel, any Coral Block, and a Wooden Sword.
Grand Minecraft Sword — Crafted from Wooden Sword, Stone Sword, Iron Sword, Gold Sword, Diamond Sword, and Netherite Sword.
Greatest Sword — Drops from Jaghax.
Nightingale's Sword (Ryusuke's Sword in older versions) — Drops from Rock-Blaze.
Beta Ray Bill Stormbreaker — Drops from Rock-Blaze.
Amber Cudgel — Crafted from Quartz Sword, Netherrack Sword, Ruby Sword, Ice Sword, Purgatory Cudgel, Rajiit Sword, Caramel Sword, and Amber Star.
Rajiit Sword — Crafted from Rajiit (Rayana stone) and Stick.
Caramel Sword — Drops from Gifts in cold Overworld biomes or the Ice Tower dungeon.
Purgatory Cudgel — Can be bought from the Purgatorium Wanderer.

 

 Next, you just need to enter the Final world and defeat the Final boss — Unahzaal — and overcome his trials! Good luck!

 

Additional Bosses and way to spawn them:
- Halloween boss — the Spirit of Halloween. Its summon item is crafted from Aerolite Nugget (found in Comets chests and dropped by Comets mobs), Hyacinthum Ingot (see Comets Crystal craft), Jack'o'Lantern, and Ectoplasm (drops from Spirits in the Overworld and Broken Souls in Soul Sand Valleys in the Nether).
- Dreadful Sapling — obtain Dreadful Seeds from the Halloween Spirit boss and right-click any Gardener's Pot with them. It becomes a Dreadful Gardener's Pot. Add 666 water and fertilizer to it to grow this plant. When it finishes growing, it becomes the boss.
- Brimstone Agaric — find the Brimstone dungeon in the caves under the vanilla Mushroom Fields biome and break the Suspicious Brimstone Fungi there.
- Piglin Warlock — right-click the structure made of Polished Blackstone, Polished Blackstone Bricks, and Gilded Blackstone with the Chronicles of Nether. 
- Tsar of Piglins — right-click a Hyacinthum Netherite Block with the Staff of the Circle of Flames.
- Arei Spirit — right-click the Arei Altar with a Ritual Activator [Arei Summoning].
- William — right-click the Ritual Stone (under which there is a Truadamantite Block and Pharoses on the sides) with a Ritual Activator [Starfall].
- Ravrite Queen — spawns naturally in the Ravrite Queen Nest structure in the Amber Plains biome in the Kingdom of Amber, or has a low chance to spawn when the player breaks or collides with a Ravrite Nest Amberwood block in the Fallen Amberwood Tree structure in the Amberwood Forest biome.
- Khogachi — find the Great Yasiden Tree structure in the Yasiden Garden biome in the Kingdom of Amber. It spawns naturally there.
- Noxifer, Forever Blind — reach -10000 Humanity in Eternal Darkness Mode and use the Daredian Moon.
- Luciden, Starfire Warrior — reach +10000 Humanity in Eternal Darkness Mode and use the Forge of the Light. 
- Ekatebrina — break Gifts in the Ice Tower to obtain Ekatebrina's Core. Activate it by crafting it with Ice Crystals and Cold Crystals. Use the Activated Ekatebrina's Core in cold biomes.
- Ekatebrina. Tier II & Ice Dragon — upgrade the Activated Ekatebrina's Core with Ice Crystals and Cold Crystals to make the Awakened Ekatebrina's Core.
- Ekatebrina [Tier III] and Everfrost Serpent — can be spawned using the Everfrost Ekatebrina's Core in the Comets Icelands biome.
- Eternal Dawn — boss for the Drink of the Sun quest. This quest can be obtained from D'Kudja in Gardens of Eden.
- Mucunfectio Crab — can spawn in any Mucunfectio biome (usually underground).
- Smuciel — find the Scary Calvary structure in Purgatorium. The boss will spawn during your exploration of this dungeon.
- Crabzilla — use the Fourteenth Flame (dropped by Unahzaal) to teleport to the Ultimate World. Find a Crabscaller and activate it. It will spawn 10 Ultimate Crabs (a more powerful version of the Mucunfectio Crab) every 10 seconds. After 100 Crabs have spawned, it will summon Crabzilla.
- Abyssaliel — find the Abyssaliel Arena structure in Volcanech. Abyssal Cultists spawn there. Obtain Sigils An, Ba, Ygon, and Sam from them. Craft the Abyssal Sigil and right-click the Abyssaliel Sigil block with it. This block is located in the middle of the Arena. Then use an Abyssal Skull on the Awakened Abyssaliel Sigil during a Blood Moon.
- Moonworm — use a Moon Slug in the Overworld during a Blue Moon.

 

Guide to the Lunar Events: 

- Lunar Events can start randomly at the start of the night with a 20% chance, or they can be summoned by the player. A Blood Moon can be summoned with a Bloody Totem, and a Blue Moon can be summoned with a Blue Moon Totem. During these events, new mobs will spawn, and some bosses can be summoned. 
- Clown Moon — A Lunar Event added as an April Fool's joke. It cannot rise on its own. The player must go to the Lands of Karvat during any Lunar Event and find the Three-Headed mob. It drops the Clown Moon Totem, which makes the Clown Moon rise.

 

Skills

There are 5 skills in Eternal Tales:
1. Growing — Grow mod plants on a Gardener's Pot. The first plant you can grow is Blueberry. Add Water (Eternal Water Bucket can also be used) — or Lava if it's a Nether Gardener's Pot — and Fertilizer into the Gardener's Pot. Then place a plant on it. If the Water and Fertilizer levels are above 50, the plant will begin to grow.
2. Digging — Mine ores and gain additional ore nuggets based on your skill level.
3. Fishing — You need a Fishing Net and some bait. Craft a Bug Net and catch some bugs, then place the Fishing Net in water (1 block of water on each side and 2 blocks below), then right-click the Net. Some fish require specific biomes or levels to catch.
4. Sorcery — At level 0, you can only break Rune Stones to upgrade your skill. Runic Stones spawn in some dimensions as structures. In the Overworld, they appear as stone posts. The Rune Prospector Enchantment on a pickaxe and the Rune Matrix on armour will increase the points and runes dropped from the Stones. 
How to craft some Sorcery items: 
Ayeris, Isaris, and Tefius Bottles — break Runic Stones to obtain Runes. Craft an Extracting Cauldron and extract the Runes in it to obtain essences. When any essence reaches 10 or more, you can place it in Soul Sand Bottles.
5. Speech — Upgrades for buying items from NPCs and completing quests. Adds discounts for some NPC trades.
6. Slaying — Upgrades for killing enemies. Grants you the ability to use Emblems — items that provide useful potion effects. 
7. Catching — Upgrades for catching bait bugs. Higher levels allow you to catch bugs with more Fishing Luck.
8. Archaeology — Upgrades for excavating suspicious blocks from the mod using a Venetium or Truadamantite Brush. Higher levels allow you to obtain more useful items.
9. Archery — Upgrades for using ranged and throwing weapons. Upgrading allows you to craft Archerer Gloves on the Jewelry Table. You can use the Treasure Hunter enchantment to obtain Rough Gems, which can be treated on the Jewelry Table to get Treated Gems with a certain quality. Then you can craft Archerer Gloves from them. Gloves increase the damage of ranged and throwable weapons. Additional damage depends on quality.
10. Fear — This skill is only for Eternal Darkness Mode. When the player has 3 or fewer HP, they gain the Fear Effect. This Effect grants Speed and Strength. The skill increases when the player kills mobs while under this effect.

How to use Ravrite Nest:

To obtain a Tamed Ravrite Nest, you need to kill the Ravrite Queen. This boss can spawn naturally in the Kingdom of Amber in the Ravrite Nest structure, or it may spawn with a 5% chance when an Amberwood Ravrite Nest block is broken.
To defeat her, you must attack the Ravrites around her — she does not take damage directly. When you kill her, you receive Ravrite Queen as an item.
Right-click on Amber Dirt or Grass Block with it in hand, and it transforms into a Tamed Ravrite Nest.
It works as follows:
Right-click it with Ravrites in hand (Ravrites can be caught with a Bug Net). The more Ravrites in the Nest, the more materials it will produce. You can take Ravrites from the Nest by right-clicking it with a Garden Shovel. If you destroy the Nest, the Ravrites will not drop.
Then you need to choose a material for recycling. It can be Geobstractsite Dust, Golden Dust, Lapsidian Dust, Quinine, or Ravrite Honey.
Ravrite Honey recycling works differently from the others.
For the first four materials, place one of them in the Nest, then place some blocks of any Amber Leaves around the Nest. When the Ravrites consume 10 blocks of Leaves, they will generate the material in an amount equal to the number of Ravrites in the Nest.
How to generate Ravrite Honey:
Place Flowering Leaves in the Nest as a material and place blocks of Flowering Leaves around it. Amber Leaves do not work for Honey. When the Ravrites consume 10 blocks of Flowering Leaves, they will generate Honey. You can right-click the Nest with Shears to get Ravrite Honeycombs, or with a Bottle to get Ravrite Honey Bottles.

- Antibacterial — Makes you immune to Infection. Can be obtained from Vaccine.
